description: Specification of tools/qa_install_config.py generate(selection, capabilities, profiles). Inputs: qa-capabilities.json and qa-install-profiles.json. A port must reproduce for every vector: ok, the error codes and fields in order, the warning codes in order and, when ok, the whole config object exactly (strings included; they come from the profile data). Messages of errors and warnings are for people and are not part of the contract. quote_vectors specify the shell quoting of one argument; canonical_json_vectors specify the form and the digest of the manifest (sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII escapes, sha256 of the ASCII bytes).

prerequisites: Python 3.12 available as `python3.12` (the packages require 3.11 or newer; 3.12 is the version the steps were run with).
git, and network access to https://github.com/redevops-io/redevops-qa (a public repository).
Network access to a Python package index for the pinned packages and for the build backend (setuptools 77 or newer, not pinned here).
All commands are run from one working directory, the one that contains the checkout, using a POSIX shell.
Google Chrome and a matching ChromeDriver installed on the host, with their absolute paths given as chrome_binary and chromedriver_path; the steps never download a browser or a driver.
macOS on Apple silicon with Python 3.12 as `python3.12`, Chrome and its ChromeDriver.

install.title: Create a clean virtual environment
Install the pinned Python packages
Install the adapter packages from the checkout (not editable, no dependency resolution)
Check that the packages are imported from the virtual environment, not from the checkout
argv: import importlib,os,sys; root=os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1]); bad=[m for m in sys.argv[2:] if not os.path.realpath(importlib.import_module(m).__file__).startswith(root+os.sep)]; sys.exit(('not imported from the virtual environment: '+', '.join(bad)) if bad else 0)
install.display: .venv-qa/bin/python -I -c 'import importlib,os,sys; root=os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1]); bad=[m for m in sys.argv[2:] if not os.path.realpath(importlib.import_module(m).__file__).startswith(root+os.sep)]; sys.exit(('"'"'not imported from the virtual environment: '"'"'+'"'"', '"'"'.join(bad)) if bad else 0)' .venv-qa qa_adapter_kit qa_selenium selenium

smoke.title: Run the shared adapter kit tests (fake adapters, offline)
Run the Selenium adapter tests (fake browser, recorded reports, offline)
Run both Selenium adapters against the real Chrome and ChromeDriver
smoke.display: QA_CHROMEDRIVER_PATH=/opt/cd/chromedriver QA_CHROME_BINARY=/Applications/chrome .venv-qa/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -c redevops-qa/pyproject.toml -o pythonpath= --junitxml=qa-evidence/junit-selenium-browser.xml -m browser redevops-qa/packages/qa-selenium/tests/browser

check.title: Fail on zero tests, any skip or any failure in junit-adapter-kit.xml
Fail on zero tests, any skip or any failure in junit-selenium-offline.xml
Fail on zero tests, any skip or any failure in junit-selenium-browser.xml

uninstall.title: Remove the virtual environment (refuses a directory that is not one)
argv: import os,shutil,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; ok=os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p,'pyvenv.cfg')); ok or sys.exit('refusing to remove a directory that is not a virtual environment: '+p); shutil.rmtree(p)
uninstall.display: python3.12 -c 'import os,shutil,sys; p=sys.argv[1]; ok=os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p,'"'"'pyvenv.cfg'"'"')); ok or sys.exit('"'"'refusing to remove a directory that is not a virtual environment: '"'"'+p); shutil.rmtree(p)' .venv-qa

evidence.description: One JUnit XML report per smoke step, written to the evidence directory; the check steps fail on zero tests, any skip or any failure. The browser report shows the adapters driving the real Chrome against a page the test serves from loopback.

config.uninstall_note: The steps leave two directories: the virtual environment (removed by the step above) and the evidence directory, which is yours to keep or delete. The checkout is an ordinary clone; delete it when you no longer need it. Nothing is installed outside these directories.
limitations: There is no release tag and no package-registry package: the install is a checkout at the pinned commit.
Transitive Python dependencies and the build backend are resolved by pip at install time and are not pinned or hash-checked.
A native engine pass or fail is not an independent verdict; no verifier is installed.
Chrome and ChromeDriver only; their versions are the host's and only the versions on the CI runner image were exercised.
